summary_zh:
這個行程位於冰島的Skálakot，提供冰島馬的騎乘體驗，適合所有喜好者。地點屬於西南岸，並且設有免費的停車場及廁所，提供便捷的現場設施。

推薦指數為★★，建議遊客停留約120分鐘以充分享受騎馬活動，並拍攝美麗的風景。這裡也是預約冰島馬體驗行程的出發點，為喜愛大自然和動物的人士提供了優質的戶外活動選擇。
summary_en: This tour is located in Skálakot on Iceland’s southwest coast and offers horseback riding on Icelandic horses for all visitors. The site provides free parking and free restroom facilities, making it convenient for travelers. It is recommended to spend about 120 minutes to fully enjoy the riding experience and capture the beautiful scenery. This location serves as the starting point for booking Icelandic horse riding tours, offering a high-quality outdoor activity for nature and animal lovers.
